messages:
carlos_finance: Noticed a spike on the GCP Marketplace invoice for Apr for partner partner-221. Looks like duplicate seat lines were billed for the reseller channel (~$12.6k). Anyone else seeing duplicated rows in the raw export?

rachel_billing: Pulling the raw export now. FYI: GCP pushed a change last week that added `reseller_label` and sometimes duplicates the `subscription_id` when partners migrate SKUs. Our dedupe used subscription_id only.

rachel_billing: sample excerpt from gcp_export_2026-04-30.csv: 
```
invoice,subscription_id,partner_id,description,amount,reseller_label
inv-20260430,sub-9988,partner-221,seat-monthly,6300,reseller:edge-03
inv-20260430,sub-9988,partner-221,seat-monthly,6300,reseller:edge-03
```

theo_sales: Oof. Partners will flag this immediately. We should proactively credit and notify.

emma_revops: Can we confirm whether these are true duplicates (same usage window) or separate meter lines? If they are true dupes, approve one-off credit.

rachel_billing: Checked timestamps/usage window: both lines are identical (2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30). Looks like export duplication during SKU migration. Delta = $12,600.

gcp-marketplace-bot: GCP Marketplace advisory: "CSV export may include duplicate subscription rows during SKU migration windows" (automated). See https://gcp.example/marketplace/sku-migration (bot).

carlos_finance: Emma, propose we issue manual credit for $12,600 and attach an explanation. Also file a billing bug to prevent double-billing on future exports.

emma_revops: Approve manual credit of $12,600. Please attach this Slack thread and tag #finance-approvals.

theo_sales: I'll draft partner comms and send on approval. Want to be transparent about cause and next steps.

rachel_billing: Created ticket BILL-2291 (dedupe by reseller_label+subscription_id) and PR to change dedupe key. Reingest scheduled for 2026-05-02 02:00 UTC.

carlos_finance: Thanks. Rachel, after reingest confirm whether GCP will accept backdated adjustments or if we need to issue the manual credit. If manual, coordinate with Accounting for ledger entries.

rachel_billing: Will confirm. If GCP doesn't adjust, we'll post a manual credit this week and include memo for audit.

emma_revops: Good. Recording approval here so audit has trace: approved $12,600 credit to partner-221 by Emma RevOps on 2026-05-01.

carlos_finance: Closing loop: tagging @theo_sales for partner notification once credit issued.
